title: POST /runner/v1/register: the request body
description: PROTOCOL.md §5.1. A body that fails this schema is 422 invalid_registration. A body with `ephemeral: true` passes whatever the rest of it holds (`if`/`then`), so that it is refused with 422 ephemeral_not_supported before the body is. The rules that need the value itself, a `name` blank once its surrounding spaces are dropped and a value over 255 characters, are checked when the machine is recorded and answer the same refusal. Other fields are ignored.

if.description: The body asks for `ephemeral`: the key is present and its value is the JSON boolean true.

name.description: Leading and trailing spaces are dropped, and it must not be blank then. At most 255 characters.

os.description: Optional, e.g. `linux`. A string of at most 255 characters: any other value, `null` included, is refused.

arch.description: Optional, e.g. `amd64`. A string of at most 255 characters: any other value, `null` included, is refused.

facts.description: What the machine reports about itself, e.g. {"docker": "27.1.0"}. Default {} when absent; `null` is refused.

ephemeral.description: Optional, default false. A JSON boolean: any other value ("true", 1, 0.0, `null`) is refused. `true` is refused with 422 ephemeral_not_supported: such a body passes this schema's `if`/`then`, whatever the rest of it holds.

auto_update.description: Default true when absent. `false` is `aixle-runner configure --no-auto-update`: the machine is never offered an update. `null` is refused.
